text:
Gold Price in 1999
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1999, the LBMA gold price rose 1.7% between 1999-01-29 ($285) and 1999-12-30 ($290). The highest sampled price was $299 in October and the lowest was $255 in August. The mean of these observations was $280. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
